svg.aria-label: Tachycardia with a pulse. Unstable patients (hypotension, altered mentation, shock, chest pain or acute heart failure) get sedation and synchronized cardioversion. Stable regular narrow-complex tachycardia: vagal maneuvers, then adenosine 6 mg and 12 mg. Polymorphic VT needs an unsynchronized shock.

tspan.tspan: Narrow, regular, no P waves: SVT
Wide and regular: treat as VT
